# Valor & Serenity

> A free, guided way to build a lasting online tribute for a veteran and the family who loved them. Not affiliated with the Department of Veterans Affairs, the Veterans Legacy Memorial, We Honor Veterans, or any hospice organization.

## About

- [Our Story](https://valorandserenity.com/about.html): Why this exists, the founder's own family story, and the site's FAQ on how it differs from official VA resources.
- [How It Works](https://valorandserenity.com/index.html#how-it-works): The 8-step guided process for building a tribute, free and always.
- [Pricing](https://valorandserenity.com/pricing.html): Basic is free, always. Story Assist is $99 one time. The Legacy Vault is $19 a year. No per-referral payments are ever made to healthcare providers.

## Story Assist

- [What Story Assist Does](https://valorandserenity.com/story-assist.html): Guided memory-provoking questions, help shaping fragments into a finished story, and sourced historical context for major milestones like a birthday or wedding day.

## A Real Example

- [Major Mike Mesarch's Tribute](https://valorandserenity.com/mike-mesarch.html): A complete, real tribute built by the founder for his own stepfather, showing every feature in actual use, including Story Assist's historical context callouts.

## For Organizations

- [For Hospice and Funeral Home Partners](https://valorandserenity.com/partners.html): A free, goodwill referral partnership, states plainly that no per-referral payments are made, ever, to stay clear of Anti-Kickback Statute concerns for regulated healthcare providers.

## For Families Navigating This Time

- [Help for Families at This Time](https://valorandserenity.com/help-for-families.html): Plain, honest information on VA burial and survivor benefits, Veteran Service Officers, and Veteran Pinning Ceremonies. Not affiliated with the VA; always confirm current details at VA.gov.
